captions.detailed: An upright arcade cabinet featuring a black main body, a slanted monitor screen, and an protruding control deck. The control deck is equipped with a joystick (consisting of a silver shaft and a red ball top) alongside a row of four colored buttons (red, yellow, blue, green). Below the control deck, a dark red service door with a silver handle is integrated into the lower cabinet face. The service door is designed to rotate on a vertical side hinge, and the joystick is designed to tilt on a central gimbal joint.
captions.instruction: Generate an upright arcade cabinet with a slanted monitor bay, a protruding control deck, and a lower service door. The control deck should feature a row of colorful buttons and a joystick consisting of a silver metal shaft and a red sphere. Ensure the service door rotates on a vertical side hinge, and the joystick tilts on a central gimbal joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main arcade cabinet by defining a profile with a slanted front face and extruding it. Create the monitor screen and upper marquee as separate visual boxes recessed or placed on the slanted face. Model the control deck as a flat box protruding forward, populated with four cylinder buttons in different colors and a joystick assembly (a cylinder shaft and a sphere ball). Build the service door with a small handle, and define articulations: a revolute joint for the side-hinged service door, and a floating gimbal joint for the joystick relative to the control deck.
